title: Monaco YAML toggle
description: "View YAML" / "Advanced" tab. Monaco editor with YAML syntax highlighting, error markers, autocomplete. Bidirectional: visual builder generates YAML, YAML edits round-trip back to visual. Diff view against active published version.
definitionOfDone: Toggle button/tab to switch between visual builder and YAML editor
Monaco editor (@monaco-editor/react) with YAML syntax highlighting
Bidirectional: visual → YAML and YAML → visual on same data model
Diff view comparing draft vs active published version

implementationPlan.description: Install @monaco-editor/react dependency: npm install @monaco-editor/react in dashboard/.

Create dashboard/src/components/policy/PolicyYamlEditor.tsx: Toggle tab 'Advanced / YAML' alongside the visual builder. Monaco editor instance (@monaco-editor/react) configured for YAML language. Loads current policy rules serialized to YAML (using yaml library already in deps). On edit: parse YAML back to rule objects, validate with Zod, update error markers in Monaco if invalid. Bidirectional sync: changes in visual builder update YAML content, YAML edits parse back to rule model and update visual builder on save/apply. Diff view toggle: shows side-by-side Monaco diff editor comparing draft YAML vs last published snapshot YAML.
implementationPlan.note: Created PolicyYamlEditor with Monaco editor, YAML syntax, error markers, diff view, and bidirectional apply

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/lib/policy-yaml.ts: Utility functions for policy YAML round-tripping. rulesToYaml(rules: PolicyRule[]): string — serializes rules to YAML. yamlToRules(yaml: string): PolicyRule[] — parses YAML back to typed rules. validatePolicyYaml(yaml: string): { valid: boolean, errors: string[] } — Zod validation of parsed rules. These ensure bidirectional fidelity.
implementationPlan.note: Created rulesToYaml, yamlToRules, and validatePolicyYaml with Zod validation
